subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What public memory-core Dream Diary timeout and cleanup contract should maintainers accept for this combined timeout, queue-time, and late-output discard failure?
rationale: The source bug is credible, but exposing timeout controls and changing timeout cleanup semantics affects public plugin config and fallback behavior that overlaps existing Dream Diary timeout, concurrency, and archived-readback threads.

options.title: Broader Narrative Contract
options.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and timeout cleanup behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Timeout-Only First
options.body: Refresh and prove the open timeout-config PR, then track queue-time accounting and late-output cleanup as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Internal Fix Without New Config
options.body: Fix queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup internally while leaving operator-facing Dream Diary controls unchanged.

recommendation.title: Broader Narrative Contract
recommendation.body: Define one public Dream Diary control shape covering timeout, queue/execution deadline semantics, and timeout cleanup behavior, then update manifest, runtime, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core and memory-host SDK history makes this the best available routing candidate for the config/runtime contract decision.
